THE ANALYSIS
The logs show no symptoms recorded across all three exposure days, which would ordinarily confirm a safe result, but your account describes bloating and a heavy, off feeling within a couple of hours of eating the milk each time, concentrated specifically on the exposure days and attributed to the food. That pattern, symptoms tied to each exposure and absent during washout, is the strongest basis for adjusting the verdict one level from Safe to Limit. There is a meaningful gap between what was logged and what you reported experiencing, and both pieces of information are noted here so you have the full picture.
RULED ON CONFLICTING EVIDENCE
Your logs and what you told us disagreed, so this verdict moved one careful step and no further. When you want a firmer answer, you can re-run this trial from your Reintro tab; the newest verdict replaces this one.
